BOUNDARY-STATE MODEL · CONTROL HANDOVER · IRREVERSIBLE CONSTRAINT

When systems
hand over control
to survive.

// A cross-disciplinary framework for human action under perceived irreversibility

Tafheena proposes a functional description of the transitional regime in which deliberative cognition attenuates while adaptive action continues — analogous to runtime assurance failover in safety-critical engineering. Positioned between flow and freeze, it frames this transition as a control-arbitration event, not instinct.

01

The Tafheena Framework

Conceptual Model

Existing models describe either optimized performance (flow, NDM) or system collapse (freeze, dissociation). The transitional boundary between these states — where deliberative control yields while action coherence persists — lacks a unified description.

Tafheena proposes a three-layer control handover architecture: a deliberative control layer (H1) governing optimization; a procedural continuity layer (H2) enabling rapid embodied execution; and an arbitration layer (H3) that monitors for perceived irreversibility and redistributes control authority.

Perceived irreversibility — not danger alone — functions as the weighting signal. When the system interprets a situation as approaching a point of no return, H3 shifts dominance to H2, preserving trajectory coherence before explicit reasoning can respond.

Actor perceives meaningful loss of reset options. Not objective danger — subjective inference of diminishing corrective margin.

Decision window compressed below normal deliberative processing capacity. Analytical reasoning becomes too slow relative to stakes.

Verbalizable deliberation attenuated during action execution. Explanation follows retrospectively — not concurrently.

Preserved Action Continuity
Motor and behavioral coherence remain intact or enhanced. Distinguishes Tafheena from freeze and collapse responses.

The Tafheena construct emerged from longitudinal phenomenological self-observation spanning over three decades — not from a controlled laboratory. Discipline-based self-regulation training initiated in childhood produced structured observational records that preceded any theoretical formulation.

From 2012 to 2025, participation in Gulf-region motorsport exposed the observer to conditions of physical and social irreversibility: high-speed vehicular dynamics combined with gender-restrictive contexts during a period of regional regulatory change. International migration across three countries added further repeated encounters with decision environments characterized by limited reversibility.

A recurring pattern became evident across these contexts: episodes in which internal continuity persisted despite temporary reduction of explanatory cognition. The academic literature review followed conceptual consolidation — consistent with phenomenological methodology that allows experiential structures to emerge prior to theoretical imposition.

// epistemic_note

Tafheena was not derived from existing frameworks but retrospectively positioned in relation to them. The observational corpus is single-participant and may reflect individual training history. The work presents a provisional hypothesis-generating model, not a validated mechanism. Empirical validation across independent participants and domains is the explicit goal.

03

Academic Preprint

CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
Tafheena: A Boundary-State Model of Control Handover Under Irreversible Constraint

Integrating perspectives from control-theoretic accounts of motor regulation, stress neuroscience, naturalistic decision-making, and safety-critical engineering runtime assurance architectures, this paper proposes Tafheena as a conceptual arbitration layer describing how control authority transitions when situations approach irreversible constraint. The model defines operational characteristics, differentiates from related constructs, and outlines testable hypotheses for empirical investigation.

04

Book — Survival Architecture

Amazon KDP · 2025

The book-length precursor to the academic framework. Where the preprint formalizes the model for interdisciplinary research, the book documents the phenomenological corpus that gave rise to it — decades of structured self-observation, real incidents, and the gradual emergence of pattern.

Traces the lived development of the Tafheena concept across motorsport environments, international migration, and high-consequence decision events. Provides the observational foundation referenced throughout the academic work.

Research Collaboration

Open Invitation

Tafheena is an open hypothesis. The framework requires empirical validation across independent participants, domains, and measurement modalities. If you work in simulation research, safety-critical systems, neurocognition, or human factors — and you see a methodological connection — direct contact is welcome.

Particularly interested in collaborators who can bring controlled experimental paradigms to the behavioral signatures and neurocognitive predictions outlined in the preprint.
